decisions.reason: Conferencing faces commoditised competition from major collaboration platforms and has shown no traction, so withdrawal is a real possibility, but it costs little to keep alongside the voice portfolio and the option can stay open a while longer.
Data centre adoption has given an early positive signal, and the product runs on owned metro infrastructure in line with the firm's direction, which justifies continued commitment.
Optical spectrum runs on owned fibre, fits the high-bandwidth strategy and is cheap to keep while demand from hyperscalers and carriers develops.
Direct voice connection is core to the enterprise voice business and inexpensive to maintain on the owned network, so there is no strong signal to abandon it.
